releaseName: Supporter Ownership + Main Board Version Repair
message: Verdant 15.4.8 stops duplicate legacy supporter layouts from re-enabling after the new list appears and places the version label on the actual active Main Board Canvas.
notes: Removes old VerdantVpmScrollKeeper components from supporter list ScrollRects.
Disables duplicate legacy supporter UI branches under the same Supporters page.
Adds VerdantSupporterOwnership1548 to keep those legacy branches disabled at runtime.
Preserves the surviving supporter list position without the previous scroll tug-of-war.
Places a V15.4.8 label on the active Main Board Canvas and sizes it from existing board typography.
Updates existing iPad/Main Board version text to V15.4.8.
